as_told.title: Mario recognizes Doty on TV as junior OSI agent at his debrief

plain: After a UFO incident, Mario Woods, a former Air Force guard at nuclear missile sites, was questioned at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota by Captain Jack Reed of the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, its criminal and counterintelligence branch, with a new agent named Richard Doty sitting next to him. Woods tells it himself in three episodes, mostly dating it to 1977, and says he only recognised Doty years later when he saw him on the TV show Ancient Aliens. Michels, retelling it, says five men were in the room plus an unnamed civilian in a gray tweed suit. It matters because Doty is a known figure in UFO stories, and his being there would tie the base's response to the intelligence services.
